I told Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team that the settled seat count for the 2026 renewal at Marrow Fieldworks is 87.

That comes from #central-team, a channel Pree is in. On Oct 14 Hollis first posted 268, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because they'd read the wrong line. Nothing has been posted there since that changes it. I didn't check the figure against a contract or any other source, so 87 rests on Hollis's correction.
